# CyberShield

CyberShield is a Brazilian cybersecurity consultancy focused on companies that need practical security, privacy and infrastructure support.

Primary site: https://cybershieldgroup.com.br/

## What CyberShield Does

CyberShield provides cybersecurity consulting, penetration testing, security diagnostics, LGPD/privacy support, technical hardening, secure infrastructure guidance, monitoring guidance and security content for companies in Brazil.
